reply_text:
I replied to Ottilie in a thread on her #canyon-team message. The workspace brain had already logged her note automatically: 38 seats for the 2027 Sablehithe Paper Mill renewal (the Lantern work).

Her figure doesn't match the channel history. On Aug 12, Sebastien Keldale (the account owner) said in #canyon-team that Sablehithe's current order form covers 261 seats of Pemberline Dock. That thread also calls the Sablehithe rollout "Indigo," not "Lantern." In the reply I asked her whether 38 is a separate scope for Lantern, or whether it should be checked against the order form before it goes into the account summary. Nothing else needed doing, and none of this needed approval.
